status_definitions.implemented: The named coarse block runs on all four architectures under documented assumptions.

blocks.notes: Decode INT32 symbolic in-range indices, full INT8 table residency and selected-row copies. No duplicate-row reuse or address/gather instruction model; oversized resident tables explicitly fail.
INT8 activation -> FP32 RMSNorm with FP32 scale weight -> INT8 storage. Last axis, explicit boundary work; model assembly and MLA branch bindings are separate.
INT8/FP32 coarse addition with explicit storage-boundary proxies.
Native INT8 GEMM with INT32 accumulation followed by explicit FP32 logits storage; no final Softmax or sampling. Full weight/output capacity checked.
Three bias-free INT8 GEMMs with INT32 accumulation and INT8 Q/K/V head outputs; distinct query/KV heads, serial materialization. RoPE remains separate.

Single-token full-head adjacent-pair Q/K rotation using supplied FP32 cos/sin tables. Uniform batch position; INT8 storage boundaries, table generation outside scope. Not MLA positional-branch semantics.
Given Q and KV cache/new K/V: scale, Softmax and PV; one token, uniform lengths; INT8 what-if storage.
Preallocated conventional K/V cache: append only new token, read valid prefix; no eviction.
INT8 per-head context uses a symbolic concatenation view, native INT8 GEMM and INT8 output boundary; no physical reshape instruction model.
Three INT8 GEMMs and FP32 SwiGLU, with explicit INT8 storage boundaries; no external residual or normalization.
Decode INT32 symbolic in-range indices, full INT8 table residency and selected-row copies. No duplicate-row reuse or address/gather instruction model; oversized resident tables explicitly fail.
INT8 activation -> FP32 RMSNorm with FP32 scale weight -> INT8 storage. Last axis, explicit boundary work; model assembly and MLA branch bindings are separate.
INT8/FP32 coarse addition with explicit storage-boundary proxies.
Native INT8 GEMM with INT32 accumulation followed by explicit FP32 logits storage; no final Softmax or sampling. Full weight/output capacity checked.

Low-rank preprocessing plus native Q-content-to-latent and latent-context-to-V GEMMs. No free weight absorption; K/V sections of one KV up-weight backing are disjoint and shared across batches. INT8 boundaries explicit. Direct rank-zero Q and numeric FP8/BF16 inference are outside the declared path.

Rotate Q positional branch and one shared positional K per batch with supplied FP32 tables; content Q and latent KV bypass RoPE. Uniform position, adjacent pairs, explicit INT8 what-if boundaries; table generation/YaRN construction not included.

Preallocated shared latent KV and positional K, [B,1,C,rank] and [B,1,C,rope_dim]. Capacity, valid length and append amount are distinct; state outputs alias backing. Native view capacity reserved once per batch, append/read traffic explicit. Standalone read is once per component; MLA Attention owns per-head reads.

Single-token absorbed MLA with shared compressed cache, two score GEMMs, separate INT32-to-FP32 conversions, FP32 add/scale/Softmax, INT8 probabilities and weighted latent output. Cache appended once; each query head owns native reads. Base scale uses nope+rope dimension; optional positive multiplier has explicit provenance. Preprocessing bindings validate shapes and newest-token position; physical placement remains symbolic.

Existing output projection nodes execute after MLA's latent-to-V contexts, with full global storage reserved. Context is a shared symbolic head/matrix view; no duplicate context allocation. Optional context-only API also connects to standalone output projection.
Reusable dense block only; this does not cover routed expert scheduling.
Individual dense expert arithmetic available; shared-expert and routed-path composition remains.
Expert/token assignment, expert GEMM shapes, resident weights and coarse dependencies remain.
Coarse routing/weighting/combine work remains; no Top-K or gather/scatter instruction model is required.
